However, that 4.6 hours of sleep is concerning this close to race day.

Your HRV at 96ms sits right at the bottom of your baseline range, which combined with the severe sleep deficit signals your body is struggling to recover. I'd recommend keeping today's session light - maybe an easy 30-minute jog or gentle movement rather than anything intense. Your body needs recovery time, not additional stress right now.
